Recommended Perks
Note: a Table of Contents can be found in the pinned messages.
​
Introduction
This channel covers the perks we suggest for your gear and how to obtain them.
​
When you see symbols in a listed perk (+ and X):
​
⬥ + represents an item with multiple gizmos slots:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• E.g.,   +  
​
⬥ X - represents where you have a choice of perks:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• E.g., 'Biting 4 X' you could choose between 9 different perks to go with  depending on your preference
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These combinations are listed in the later sections of this channel
​



















Related Guides & Links
⬥ #invention-basics is a must-read if you're new to Invention 

⬥ #perk-information describes every perk we recommend.

⬥RuneScape Wiki's Perk Search lets you search a perk combination to find which component setup is best.

⬥ RuneScape Wiki's Perk Calculator lets you test out component combinations and see your chance of different perks.

⬥ Shattered Worlds is the fastest way to level up your augmented gear.
    • Video guides: Base Tank / Evil Lucario
    • Alternatively, level up your gear using a slayer mob in #rs3-slayer.








​
Recommended Perks
Starter Perks


















Many starter perks are decent & inexpensive and may well last your entire PvM career.

Requirements
⬥ Level 68 Invention 
⬥ Extreme Invention Potion 
    • Note: Eruptive 4  is the exception, requiring Level 86 
Main Weapons
⬥     Main-hand - Precise 6 
⬥     Off-hand - Eruptive 4 
⬥    Two-handed - Precise 6  + Eruptive 4 
Weapon Switches
⬥     Flanking - Flanking 4 
⬥    Planted Feet - Planted Feet 
Armour / Shields
⬥    Body - Equilibrium 1  + Impatient 4 
⬥  Body (Magic) - Biting 3  + Impatient 4 
⬥     Legs - Crackling 4  + Enhanced Devoted 4 
⬥    Shield - Turtling 4 
    • For Necromancy  just use Bone Shield  / 








​
Advanced Weapon Perks

















Magic 

Use 2H perks for   if using them as primary weapons
⬥  2-handed - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 + Precise 6 Ultimatums 4 
⬥  Main-hand - Caroming 4 Aftershock 1
⬥  Off-hand - Lunging 4 Eruptive 2
⬥  Flanking switch - Flanking 4 Eruptive 1
⬥  Planted Feet switch - Planted Feet, or Caroming 4 Planted Feet
⬥  Caroming switch - Caroming 4 Eruptive 2


























Melee 

⬥   Main-hand - Precise 6 Aftershock 1
⬥  Off-hand - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2
⬥   Flanking switch - Flanking 4 Eruptive 1
⬥   2-handed - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2 + Precise 6 Ruthless 1
⬥   Halberd (AoE) - Aftershock 4 Precise 2 + Eruptive 4 Ruthless 3
⬥  MW Spear of Annihilation - Precise 6 Aftershock 1 + Lunging 4 Eruptive 2
⬥  Statius' Warhammer - Aftershock 1


























Necromancy

⬥   Main-hand - Precise 6 Aftershock 1
⬥   Off-hand - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2
⬥  Switch - Flanking 4 Eruptive 1






See !necroperks for an explanation of why reversed perks are no longer recommended.




















Ranged 

⬥    2-handed - Precise 6 Caroming 1 + Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2
⬥  Main-hand - Precise 6 Aftershock 1
⬥  Off-hand - Caroming 4 Eruptive 2
⬥  Hydrix Grico switch - Caroming 4 + Aftershock 1
⬥  Off-hand (for ) - Aftershock 4 Eruptive 2
⬥  (Off-style) SGB - Precise 6 Aftershock 1 + Eruptive 4 Ruthless 3
⬥  Planted Feet switch - Aftershock 1 + Planted Feet









Advanced Armour/Shield Perks

















Magic 

⬥     Body - Biting 4 X + Relentless 5 Crackling 4
⬥     Legs - Impatient 4 X + Energizing 4 Invigorating 3 
⬥  Merciless Kiteshield - Turtling 4
⬥  Arcane Spirit Shield - Lucky 4 Absorbative 2


























Melee 

⬥   Body - Biting 4 X + Relentless 5 Crackling 4
⬥   Legs - Impatient 4 X + Ultimatums 4 X
⬥  Malevolent Kiteshield - Turtling 4


























Necromancy 

⬥   Body - Equilibrium 4 X + Crackling 4 Ultimatums 4
⬥   Legs - Impatient 4 X + Invigorating 4 X


























Ranged 

⬥   Body - Biting 4 X + Relentless 5 Crackling 4
⬥   Legs - Impatient 4 X + Ultimatums 4 X









​
